spec: Format 5.2.4: a token may be $deprecated, true or a reason. A reference to a deprecated token, an alias or a JSON Pointer into its value (7.1.2), is a warning at the reference with the reason the token gives, none for true. A token deprecated by its group counts (6.3.1), one that writes false does not; a reference to a token that is not deprecated, and a pointer into a deprecated token's own value, are not reported
